introduction: In this video, let’s retrace the history of piracy, from the first mentions during the antiquity unt
lead_intro: Piracy has a long history dating back to ancient times, with various famous pirates and privateers making their mark on the high seas. Let's dive into a quiz to test your knowledge on the evolution of piracy!

quiz.question: In the 14th century B.C., who were mentioned as operating in the eastern Mediterranean Sea and organizing attacks in the Nile Delta?
quiz.explanation: The Egyptians mentioned the 'peoples of the sea' as operating in the eastern Mediterranean Sea and organizing attacks in the Nile Delta.

quiz.question: Who captured Julius Caesar when he was only a soldier in 75 BC?
quiz.explanation: Julius Caesar was captured by Cilician pirates in the Aegean Sea in 75 BC.

quiz.question: Which pirate settled in Saint Lucia and attacked passing ships in the middle of the 16th century?
quiz.explanation: Privateer François Le Clerc settled in Saint Lucia in the middle of the 16th century to attack passing ships.

quiz.question: Who changed his plan to become a pirate while on his way to attack French forts in Africa as a privateer?
quiz.explanation: Thomas Tew changed his plan while on his way to attack French forts in Africa as a privateer, turning to piracy instead in the Indian Ocean.

quiz.question: Which pirate, nicknamed Blackbeard, led a blockade of Charleston with 5 ships in the Caribbean?
quiz.explanation: Edward Teach, also known as Blackbeard, led a blockade of Charleston with 5 ships in the Caribbean.
